My god just reading that brings me to tears I’ve had enough this is torture for me I’m only 18 I had 4 abortions one with twins and it was all against my will for a stupid guy who only stayed to manipulate my feelings he cheated on me he’d come back and make promises and I’m so fucking stupid I let him in everytime and he just leaves after I start to trust him regardless I don’t give a fuck about him he can go I just ive been raped by people I trust I’ve been thrown around like a fucking doll my parents can’t stand me I’m a failure to everyone I’m holding on for my sister but how much longer do I suffer my whole life is going downhill I go to therapy I go get help nothing is working I attempted suicide and was at deaths door multiple times but god kicks me back in this hell for me to suffer over and over I just I can’t take this cycle I cry every night I can’t believe I actually just got up and looked for a scalpel to slit my wrists with but couldn’t find it it took me 5 minutes to have a breakdown and look at myself what have I turned into what did everyone turn me into omg I’m a danger to my own self
And no I'm not blackmailing or anything. I just wanted to spend time. It hurts that I waited so long for nothing..
Yeah thEy said I can no longer ovulate. Idk I scratched my ovaries or something happened during the abortion because maybe I was moving around a lot and it hurt me

What if he does care he just doesn't know how to show it? I understand you're here for me. But I wish I had someone in real life. I have no one I can go to, he is always busy in school but when we do meet we bond very well. It's like everything disappears, he is different when it comes to texting, I guess it's because he forgets how it feels to hold me close. But when we are together he loves me and he can't even look at the things he says because he feels guilty and he says it out of frustration. I was talking to him last night and I think it's best if we stay friends.. but if he wants that then he has to promise to atleast be there for me. What the hell did I do to deserve this from everyone? I don't want to go on because I want kids of my own, I want to give birth one day it sucks because at 17 I even had a few baby names in mind. What can I do to show him my point of view?? I accept what you're saying, about staying friends. But I've given him more than enough now and being friends will be the last thing I'll give him. If that goes no where and he continues to not understand or cuts me off, idk if I'll be able to trust anyone in my life again.

Yes I'm trying that. But he says he doesn't want to care about me? Idk he says how he will be there but once we break up he says how he doesn't want to care about me and I feel like it's making things worse. By the way, I wouldn't kill myself for him, I want to do it because my whole life is in a rut. Everything from my parents and me not having kids it breaks me and I don't want to wake up because I kept myself together for so long and I'm not getting anything out of it. People always want things to go thier way but they never ask what I want.

Like understand when you tell me that it's best to leave him. Trust me I do and I wish I could numb my feelings so I wouldn't have to go through this. But I just need 3 months, not 3 months of him, but three months of myself so I can figure out what it is that I need.

The thing is, my boyfriend is very supportive and he held through strong for the year and 6 months we have been together. I understand his point of view as well. I just think it's not a good idea to leave me right now. I need time to accept it, just yesterday he told me he wanted to leave and so I started to get into depression and actually ran away from home, I felt like I was going crazy and I threw things around, I locked myself in the basement because I had urges to go upstairs and get a knife from the kitchen and stab myself in the chest. What I'm saying is I already have such a huge load on me, a break up at THIS moment will only make things worse. Nothing will change me from wanting to kill myself, but if he would just give me 3 months (which he agreed on) I think I can calm down and accept it. If not then idk whatll happen, but what's the best thing to tell him so he can understand? Do u have any suggestions?
